answer: A tight ring of 158 clones thus holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Because the prism calculation reruns each epoch, the onyx weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the ripple settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 42% independent neighbours on the funding graph. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
